our_interpretation: “Elon” means xAI's AI development efforts; the comparison is with OpenAI.
The plain reading of “moving faster” is faster demonstrated capability progress. Release frequency and infrastructure expansion are possible indicators, not equivalent measures.
“Nipping at their heels” means close technical competition, without requiring superiority on every task.
“Frayed” means documented material strain in the partnership, not its termination.

The target period is 2025 through the post date, reflecting the ongoing competitive trajectory and relationship state. This year-to-date window is an evaluator choice because the speaker supplies no starting date.

The three assertions are assessed together. Support requires all three; established support and established contradiction of different parts would justify mixed. A material unmeasured part leaves the combined claim unresolved.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable evidence shows xAI progressing faster than OpenAI, several rivals close to OpenAI's capabilities, and material Microsoft partnership tensions during the period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evidence establishes the opposite of the asserted development pace or competitive proximity, or reliable records rebut the alleged partnership strain.
